# Roofing Systems Co.

> Roofing Systems Co. installs a done-for-you client acquisition system for roofing contractors doing $1M+ per year: offer positioning, Meta (Facebook & Instagram) ads, ad creatives, landing pages, sales funnel, CRM setup, AI follow-up, email and SMS sequences, and lead qualification. The goal is to double a roofing company's revenue within 90 days, backed by a written agreement.

- Who it's for: roofing contractors in the United States doing $1M+ in annual revenue.
- What clients do: run the booked appointments and close the jobs. Roofing Systems Co. builds and operates everything before the appointment.
- Guarantee: growth milestones agreed in writing for the first 90 days; if they aren't hit, work continues with no management fee until they are.
- Ownership: clients own their landing pages, funnel, CRM, automations, creatives, copy, follow-up sequences and customer data.
- Contracts: no long-term lock-in.
- Based in: Phoenix, Arizona, USA. Serves roofers nationwide.
- Operated by: Vaishali Media Productions LLC.

## Frequently asked questions

### What exactly is Roofing Systems™?

It's a complete done-for-you client acquisition system built for roofing companies. We handle offer positioning, Meta ads, ad creatives, landing pages, the full sales funnel, CRM setup, AI follow-up, email and SMS sequences, and lead qualification — all managed for you.

### Who is this for?

Roofing contractors doing $1M+ in annual revenue who want predictable, repeatable growth instead of lead-dependent chaos. If you're tired of overpaying for marketing with nothing to show for it, this is built for you.

### How fast will I see results?

Most clients see measurable lead growth within 30–45 days of launch. Every engagement is backed by mutually agreed growth milestones we commit to hitting within the first 90 days.

### What happens if it doesn't work?

We continue working for you at no management fee until we help you hit the agreed milestones. Everything is backed by a written agreement, so the risk sits on us, not you.

### Do I actually own the assets?

Yes. Landing pages, sales funnel, CRM, automations, ad creatives, copy, follow-up sequences, and your customer data are 100% yours — permanently. It becomes a business asset you own outright.

### Is there a long-term contract lock-in?

No. We don't lock you in with long-term contracts. We earn the renewal by delivering results, not by trapping you in a commitment.

### How is this different from a traditional agency?

Agencies run ads and hand you raw, unqualified leads. We build and operate the entire acquisition engine end-to-end — and our proprietary qualification process filters leads before they ever reach your sales team, so your crew spends time closing roofing projects, not chasing tire-kickers.
